sections.content: The repository uses hash-bound, fail-closed skill-input contexts with separate execution, publication, lifecycle, and acceptance responsibilities. Context selection and source-content identities are independent. Persisted evidence is immutable and non-authorizing unless a designated lifecycle owner publishes it.
sections.title: Workflow governance

sections.content: The toolchain workflow repair plan defines TWR-W0 through TWR-W6 for typed source selection, bounded transport, coverage verification, knowledge gate routing, immutable generations, approval-gated retention, and end-to-end migration. The implementation contract requires deterministic RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR evidence for each slice.
sections.title: Repair plan

sections.content: All listed sources have complete single-page coverage and accepted bounded summaries. Command registries define shell-free tests and terminal validation. The supplied material describes implementation and evidence controls without publishing lifecycle completion or acceptance outcomes.
